name: manuscript-studio
description: Shared manuscript preparation, analysis, editing, translation, interior-design proposals, querying, and approval.

interface.longDescription: Prepare verified chapter Markdown, analyze manuscript plot and characters through a shared evidence-bound story ledger, assess and edit literary manuscripts, translate Chinese-English prose, propose book interior designs, and develop literary-agent query materials. Interior design returns a structured proposal, not generated DOCX/PDF or approval. Analysis supplies skill-level reading and review contracts; automatic analysis workflow integration is separate work. Interactive literary reviews require a Codex-compatible inline visualization surface; other environments use revision-bound text decisions. File access, Python, dependencies, and web research depend on the host. See the runtime support guide linked from the project website.
defaultPrompt: Assess my manuscript and propose edits for my approval.
Translate my literary manuscript while preserving its voice.
Propose typography and an interior layout for my prepared manuscript.
